english.title: Obstruct power exercised by employee of fire and rescue authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse, obstructed the exercise of a power to **(..SPECIFY POWER..) under section 45 or 46 of the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004 exercised by **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED OFFICER..), an employee of a fire and rescue authority who was authorised in writing by the authority for the purposes of section 45 of the Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46(6)(a) and (7) of the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004.
